def calculate_fibonacci(n):
    if n == 0:
        return 0
    if n == 1:
        return 1
    fib = [0] * (n + 1)
    fib[1] = 1
    for i in range(2, n + 1):
        fib[i] = fib[i-1] + fib[i-2]
    return fib

# Calculate up to F_30
F = calculate_fibonacci(30)

# Print F_2 through F_30
print("F_2 to F_30:")
for i in range(2, 31):
    print(f"F_{i}: {F[i]}")

# Also check the size of F_30 for magnitude analysis
print(f"\nF_30 has {len(str(F[30]))} digits.")
